title: 实验 2-1 · 叠加定理：两台电源分别作用再相加
summary: 9 V 和 5 V 两台电源一起驱动 R3。用两个开关把电源换成导线，分别测，再一起测：电流正好相加。
concepts: zeroing a voltage source = short 电压源置零 = 短路
power is not superposable 功率不能叠加
description:
**目标**：线性电路中，多个独立源共同作用的响应 = 每个源单独作用的响应之和。

**电路**：两台稳压电源 V1 = 9 V、V2 = 5 V，负极连在一起作为 GND。
- S1：a 侧接 V1 的 +，b 侧接 GND，com → R1（1kΩ）→ 结点 N；
- S2：a 侧接 V2 的 +，b 侧接 GND，com → R2（2.2kΩ）→ 结点 N；
- N → 电流表 AM1（红表笔接 N）→ R3（3.3kΩ）→ GND。

**怎么让一个电源“不起作用”**：叠加定理里“电压源置零”是把它换成**短路**，不是断开！开关拨到 b，就是把 R1（或 R2）的那一端从电源上拿下来接到 GND——相当于这个电源变成了一根导线。

**先预测**：用结点电压法 U_N = (V1/R1 + V2/R2) / (1/R1 + 1/R2 + 1/R3)，分别算出只有 V1、只有 V2、两个都接时的 U_N 和 R3 的电流 I3。检查：两个单独作用的 I3 加起来，是否等于一起作用时的 I3？R3 的功率也能这样相加吗？

**测量**：开关依次拨到（a, b）、（b, a）、（a, a），每次读 AM1，并测 N 点对 GND 的电压。电路检查通过后，把读数填进下面的「测量」（以你自己的面包板为准）；答完后会显示计算对比。

**想一想**：只有 V2 时，R1 的电流是 −1.29 mA——电流从 N 经 R1 流到 GND，方向和两个电源都接时相反。

en.title: Experiment 2-1 · Superposition: two supplies one at a time, then together
en.summary: A 9 V and a 5 V supply drive R3 together. Two switches replace each supply with a wire; measure each one alone, then both: the currents add up exactly.
concepts: zeroing a voltage source = short circuit
en.description:
**Goal**: in a linear circuit, the response to several independent sources together equals the sum of the responses to each source alone.

**Circuit**: two bench supplies V1 = 9 V and V2 = 5 V, negatives joined as GND.
- S1: side a to V1 +, side b to GND, com → R1 (1kΩ) → node N;
- S2: side a to V2 +, side b to GND, com → R2 (2.2kΩ) → node N;
- N → ammeter AM1 (red lead at N) → R3 (3.3kΩ) → GND.

**How to "switch off" a source**: in superposition, zeroing a voltage source means replacing it with a **short circuit**, not opening it! Switching to b takes that end of R1 (or R2) off the supply and puts it on GND: the source has become a wire.

**Predict first**: with nodal analysis, U_N = (V1/R1 + V2/R2) / (1/R1 + 1/R2 + 1/R3), work out U_N and R3's current I3 with V1 only, V2 only and both on. Check: do the two single-source values of I3 add up to the value with both on? Can R3's power be added the same way?

**Measure**: set the switches to (a, b), (b, a) and (a, a); each time read AM1 and measure N to GND. Once the circuit check passes, type your readings into the Measurements below (whatever your own board shows); the worked comparison appears after you answer.

**Think about it**: with V2 alone, R1's current is −1.29 mA: current flows from N through R1 to GND, the opposite way to when both sources are on.

measurements.ask: V1 only (S1→a, S2→b): AM1 reading I3′
V2 only (S1→b, S2→a): AM1 reading I3″
Both on (a, a): AM1 reading I3
measurements.explain: I3 = I3′ + I3″ ≈ 1.55 + 0.39 = 1.94 mA: superposition holds.

measurements.ask: Both on: node N to GND, U_N
From your three current readings, R3's power P = I²R: compared with I3²R, I3′²R + I3″²R is
measurements.explain: ≈ 7.9 + 0.5 = 8.4 mW, but 1.94² × 3.3 ≈ 12.5 mW. (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab, and the 2ab is the difference: power goes with the square of the current and does not superpose.
choices: smaller than the power with both sources on
larger than the power with both sources on

hints: Two supplies: one on the top rails, one on the bottom rails, and a jumper joining the two blue rails as GND.
Each switch: side a to the supply +, side b to GND (really to GND, not left open), the middle com to the resistor.
Ammeter red lead at node N, black lead toward R3.
tests: V1 only (S1→a, S2→b): sensible I3 and N
V2 only (S1→b, S2→a): sensible I3 and N
Both on (a, a): I3 is the sum of the two single-source currents

tests.name: 只有 V1（S1→a，S2→b）：I3 和 N 点电压合理
只有 V2（S1→b，S2→a）：I3 和 N 点电压合理
两个都接（a，a）：I3 等于两次单独作用之和

measurements.ask: 只有 V1（S1→a，S2→b）：AM1 的读数 I3′
只有 V2（S1→b，S2→a）：AM1 的读数 I3″
两个都接（a，a）：AM1 的读数 I3
两个都接：N 点对 GND 的电压 U_N

choices: 单独作用的两个功率加起来，比一起作用时的功率小
两者相等：功率也满足叠加定理
单独作用的两个功率加起来，比一起作用时的功率大
measurements.ask: 用你的三个电流读数算 R3 的功率 P = I²R：I3′²R + I3″²R 和 I3²R 相比，
measurements.explain: ≈ 7.9 + 0.5 = 8.4 mW，而 1.94² × 3.3 ≈ 12.5 mW。(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab，多出的 2ab 就是差别：功率和电流是平方关系，不能叠加。

hints: 两台电源：一台接上方电源轨，一台接下方电源轨，用跳线把两条蓝轨连起来当 GND。
开关的 a 侧接电源 +，b 侧接 GND（一定是接 GND，不是空着），中间 com 接电阻。
电流表红表笔接结点 N，黑表笔接 R3。
